text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Next year is my senior year… There's a bunch of big races ahead.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There are so many races I have to run if I'm going to become someone that makes everyone happy…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But there was a time when I didn't even know what to aim for anymore. I would go out to the track, but my legs just wouldn't start moving…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Then I forced myself to go out to the track one day, and I happened to see something amazing.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Nature
text_block_list.text: YAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That looks fun…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to run too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup, hup!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, it's getting warm! Running in the morning really does feel great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning, as our preparations for the Diamond Stakes continue…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that Rice way out there? I guess she's doing some morning training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whew! One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have to get stronger before Bourbon recovers!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rrrraaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What a burst of speed! I guess she's over whatever was bothering her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What a relief! She had me pretty worried back there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From that day onward, we see Rice Shower out on the track running her heart out every day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, wheeze, pant… It's hard to… breathe…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I can still keep going!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: HAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, one day…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Phew!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, that's it for today! And my time's looking good too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Great job today, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bourbon! Are you running again?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, I can't run at full capacity yet. I'm doing some walking instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I want to get back to my original training, but the doctor "explicitly forbid" me from pushing myself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, fortunately enough, it appears I'll recover earlier than expected.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really?! That's great!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You're looking a lot better! You seemed pretty down when I went to see you in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes… That's true. I was in a state of "dejection" at that time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I had just run in the Kikuka Sho and was in a state of "hype" for my senior year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I bet…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But still, you're really something! Despite all that, you're still back on your feet and out here walking!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, my analysis indicates that my recovery is due to something beyond my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I saw Rice running recently.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Everything about her has improved since we last raced—her form, her speed, and her times.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure why myself, but I couldn't take my eyes off her as she ran.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It reminded me of the praise we exchanged when we were competing for the Classic Triple Crown, and the promise we made to continue competing in our senior year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: She looked so small, running up the ramp so far away…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But it felt like she was telling me, "You can't give up here."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So she inspired you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes… Rice is an incredible Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is much quieter than usual on our way back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rice is the one who inspired Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All I did was tell Bourbon that everything would be okay back at the hospital…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But just the sight of Rice running was way, waaay more helpful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she speaks, Matikanetannhauser's cheeks appear flushed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Isn't that just… amazing?! I can't find the right words to describe it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rice motivated Bourbon just by being herself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That means that Rice is like her… well, I don't think "hero" is exactly the right word.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But she's like this shining figure in her heart that gives her the courage and strength to keep going…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She's her star.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Her star. That's the word I'm looking for.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rice is Bourbon's star. She's incredible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after that, as if savoring the word, the continues to say the word "star" over and over again.
